name: motion-spin-stop
title: Spin Stop
description: Ô xoay hai vòng thật nhanh rồi chậm dần, dừng đúng một góc bội của 90°.

moworks.author: moworks

options.marker: the stop marker (a ring pings there)
options.pingAt: share of the spin when the ring pings (0.7)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Tile spins 0 → 720° and stops on a 90° multiple: recipe 850 ms power3.out (easeOutQuart); small demo 1200 ms custom(.3,.45,.15,1). Five motion copies 12 ms apart at up to 16 % opacity scaled by speed; as it lands a small ring pings at the stop marker (radius 5 → 19 px, 430 ms power2.out). Params: duration (0.85 s) · turns: số vòng (2) · ease (power3.out).
moworks.titleVi: Xoay nhanh rồi dừng đúng góc
